summary: Two churches: St. Francis of Assisi (with the Blessed Sacrament Chapel at the same address) and Immaculate Heart of Mary. The weekend, weekday, Spanish and first-Friday Masses and the chapel's Mon-Fri 6 AM-9 PM Adoration agree in both bulletins (Nov 8, Nov 15) and on the website; the Nov 18 Wednesday Mass is cancelled and a Nov 26 noon Mass is added. Open: Saturday 3-4 PM Confession, printed only in the Nov 8 bulletin.
